info.name: Commercetools Customers API
info.description:
Operations tagged Customers across 2 of this provider's published API definitions: commercetools-http-api-openapi.yml, commercetools-import-api-openapi.yml. Each path carries the servers of the definition it was published in.

Contact Support:
 Name: commercetools Support
